rows.text: PIB's archive carries the President's Secretariat press communique of 13 May 2004, timed 19:30 IST, in the same words as the President's website communique id 229: the Prime Minister, Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee, has tendered his resignation and that of his colleagues, and the President has accepted it and requested him and his colleagues to continue in office till alternative arrangements are made.
